hero_subhead: Select Founders Organization products are designated Impact Products™ — a fixed 10% of the purchase price supports a partner nonprofit, tracked openly and reconciled by hand.

how_steps.title: A product is designated
how_steps.description: The Co.LLab marks a specific product as an Impact Product and sets a fixed percentage — currently 10%.

how_steps.title: The allocation is recorded
how_steps.description: At the moment of purchase, that percentage of the sale is logged to an internal ledger, tied to the nonprofit partner.

how_steps.title: Totals are public
how_steps.description: Aggregate totals per partner are shown below — no purchase details, no customer information, just the running total.

how_steps.title: Funds are remitted
how_steps.description: The Co.LLab reconciles and sends the allocated amount to each partner directly, on a regular cadence.

how_notice: Honesty matters here: Stripe is not automatically splitting or transferring these funds to the nonprofit partners in real time. Unless a partner has its own Stripe Connect account on file, the 10% obligation is tracked internally and remitted by The Co.LLab directly to the organization. The ledger and totals below reflect what has been allocated and what has been sent.
products_note: Additional products may be designated as Impact Products over time. Each one is marked clearly, both here and on its own page.
closing_headline: Build your own infrastructure, and support good work along the way.
